copy.curiosityHook: Unable to confess his feelings directly, what indirect channel does Cyrano devise to reach Roxane's heart?
copy.description: Brilliant swordsman and poet Cyrano de Bergerac harbors a secret devotion to Roxane. Convinced his prominent nose makes him unlovable, he holds his tongue until discovering a roundabout path to voice his devotion.
copy.vibeSummary: Deliberate, heartfelt period romance balancing witty comedic energy with thoughtful emotional weight.
copy.whyWatch: Jean-Paul Rappeneau balances grand period romance with sparkling verbal wit and ache, making this adaptation an emotionally resonant blend of lively humor and tender longing.

allowedMaterial: Cyrano's dual talents as swordsman and poet
His self-consciousness regarding his large nose
His choice to express his feelings indirectly
excludedMaterial: Identity of his surrogate or collaborator in the courtship
